chunks: He said: Abu Ubaidullah Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me, saying: Abu al-Fadl Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Tusi narrated to us, saying: Abu Abd al-Rahman Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Hanbal narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn Abi Saminah narrated to us, saying: Ubaidullah ibn Musa narrated to us, saying: Matar al-Iskaf narrated to us, saying: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, said:
"Verily, my brother, my minister, and my successor among my family, and the best of those I leave behind -- who will repay my debts and fulfil my pledges -- is Ali ibn Abi Talib."

key_terms.خليفة: Khalifah (successor/deputy) -- one who takes the place of another, here denoting succession in the Prophet's family
key_terms.دين: Dayn (debt) -- financial and moral obligations left by the Prophet
key_terms.وزير: Wazir (minister/helper) -- one who bears responsibilities on behalf of another, here denoting Ali's role as the Prophet's chief aide

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about Ali being his brother and successor?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared that Ali ibn Abi Talib is his brother, minister, and successor among his family, and the best person he leaves behind, who will repay his debts and fulfil his promises. This hadith, transmitted through a Sunni chain including the son of Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal, was originally addressed to the Muslim community to establish Ali's preeminence and his unique responsibilities after the Prophet's passing.
